title: Compact Complex Threefolds Fibred by Two-Dimensional Complex Tori
summary: We construct two families of compact complex threefolds fibred over $\mathbb P^1$ by two-dimensional complex tori. For each positive integer $r$ and each parameter $c$ in a fixed half-plane, the families $Y_{r,c}$ and $Z_{r,c}$ have two multiple fibres of multiplicities $(4,6)$ and $(3,6)$, respectively, and one reduced normal-crossings fibre whose normalization consists of $r$ del Pezzo surfaces of degree six.
